name: emotional-support
description: Emotional Support companion panel for VS Code-based IDEs

commands.title: Emotional Support: Cycle Emotional Support Mood (Demo)
Emotional Support: Install user-level Cursor hook
Emotional Support: Show Session Mood Summary
Emotional Support: Show Current Vibe Status

emotional-support.accentColor.description: Accent color for the robot (chest plate, ears, antenna). Use a hex color value (e.g. #ff9f43).

emotional-support.bodyColor.description: Body color for the robot (torso, head, hands, feet). Use a hex color value (e.g. #ffffff).

emotional-support.visorColor.description: Visor color on the robot's face. Use a hex color value (e.g. #343a40).

emotional-support.limbColor.description: Limb color for the robot's arms. Use a hex color value (e.g. #aabbaa).

emotional-support.defaultEyeColor.description: Default eye color for the robot in idle/coding state. Use a hex color value (e.g. #00d2d3).

emotional-support.successEyeColor.description: Eye color when the robot is in a success state. Use a hex color value (e.g. #1dd1a1).

emotional-support.errorEyeColor.description: Eye color when the robot is in an error state. Use a hex color value (e.g. #ff5252).

emotional-support.idleAnimations.description: Enable or disable autopilot idle animations (walking, dancing, peeking).

emotional-support.reactToClicks.description: Whether the robot reacts when you click on the panel (wave, look, wake up).

emotional-support.animationSpeed.description: Speed multiplier for robot animations. Values above 1 make the robot more energetic, below 1 more relaxed.

emotional-support.movementSpeed.description: Speed multiplier for robot walking and running movement.

emotional-support.defaultTemperature.description: Default animation temperature (0–1). Controls overall intensity of robot movements. 0 = very calm/minimal, 0.5 = normal, 1 = hyper/energetic. Workspace vibe and MCP commands can override this dynamically.

emotional-support.unfocusedSleepDelay.description: Seconds of inactivity before the robot falls asleep when the window is unfocused.

emotional-support.disabledActions.description: List of actions to exclude from autopilot and unfocused behaviors. Core actions (idle, coding, etc.) cannot be disabled.

emotional-support.vibeReactions.description: Enable automatic robot reactions based on workspace signals (errors, save frequency, git status). The robot emotionally responds to your coding session.

enumDescriptions: Warm and encouraging — cheers you on and offers comfort during tough times
Witty and irreverent — roasts your bugs with love
Calm and factual — just the facts, minimal emotion
emotional-support.personality.description: Robot personality that influences the tone of messages.

emotional-support.highErrorThreshold.description: Number of errors that represents 'maximum stress' for the stress score calculation.

emotional-support.showThoughtBubbles.description: Show floating thought bubbles above the robot with messages and reactions.

emotional-support.showControlPanel.description: Show the Control Panel view in the Emotional Support sidebar (for debugging and testing).

emotional-support.thoughtBubbleDuration.description: How long (in seconds) thought bubbles stay visible before fading.

scripts.compile: npm run build:webview && npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run build:webview && npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
